guidelines.detail: refines GW-06 (The description lists both question/input work and button/data-collection work, and says further questions depend on a condition. The missing flow from a parallel gateway to data collection and the missing conditional branch support this modeling guidance. The guideline refines GW-06 by distinguishing always-required parallel work from condition-dependent work.)

same as LRN-070 (The labels differ in specificity: some reference labels add details not stated in the description, while others omit details that are stated. This guideline captures that general issue and is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-070.)

refines GW-01 (The description explicitly says additional questions depend on results, and the cited reference flows show a decision point for that optional work. This specifies how to apply GW-01’s general guidance to identify gateway behavior.)

same as LRN-070 (The description supports the activity and decision meanings, while the generated labels diverge from the reference labels. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-070.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description distinguishes entering two attributes, while the generated model combines them into one task. FID-02 already advises against merging separately described actions.)

same as LRN-070 (The description supports the generated labels’ level of detail, while the reference labels add unsupported specifics or omit described actions: for example, it mentions additional questions without a fill-level decision (P1, S4), buttons without naming a particular button (P3, S3), and entering both machine type and serial number (P4, S2). This supports a general label-faithfulness guideline, whic)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple kinds of work during the same stage and states that additional work occurs only when a condition holds: Model the work required in every case as parallel branches. Model condition-dependent work with an inclusive split and join so that only activated branches are synchronized.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple kinds of work during the same stage and states that additional work occurs only when a condition holds

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient: Label the corresponding BPMN element so that it preserves the described action, object, scope, and direction; do not replace them with a related action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states activities or decisions but does not specify their full operational details

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that whether additional activities occur depends on the outcome of earlier work: Model the alternatives with an exclusive gateway, and label its outgoing sequence flows with the conditions that determine whether the additional activities occur.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that whether additional activities occur depends on the outcome of earlier work

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple distinct attributes that are entered before subsequent work begins.
